decisions.why: Today organization_id is the ZITADEL (login service) org used for staff, customers and vendors alike. Fixing it now is a day or two; after P2/P3 it is a data migration of live ledgers.

Approvals already taken keep their snapshot, so changing later only affects new ones.

options.detail: More flexible but several rules to maintain and explain.

decisions.recommendationWhy: It is what the team and architects proposed, and it is the safer (earlier-triggering) basis.

decisions.why: The spec has no Procurement, Receiver (goods receipt) or Operations Head role, and approvals also need a 'department head / line manager' step type. Without them P2 and P4 routes cannot be seeded. Department heads need to be confirmed by name.

Evidence: `deck/notes-part1.md:396`.

decisions.title: Business OS: how should remote admin/ops access to the office PC work?
decisions.why: - Asked: 2026-11-10 (Codex (gpt-6.1-sol)). Kuu dropped the admin tunnel. Application admin sign-in uses the normal reverse proxy over HTTPS with ZITADEL login; that does not provide host maintenance access. Should host access use SSH (Secure Shell) over a public IP with key-only login plus CrowdSec, a VPN (virtual private network) of Kuu's choice, or none? Recommendation: no remote host access for now, until Kuu confirms the operational need and access method; do not publish a new host-management port as part of this removal. - When answered, update: `Yes/business-os/README.md`, `Yes/business-os/docs/BLUEPRINT.md`, `Yes/business-os/docs/REQUIREMENTS-AND-STACK.md` supersession note, `Yes/business-os/docs/html/business-os-technical-brief.html`, `Yes/business-os/docs/platform/system-map/model.js`, `Yes/business-os/docs/platform/P0-PLAN.md`, `Yes/business-os/docs/platform/pstack/P0-architect.md`, `Yes/business-os/docs/platform/cascade/CASCADE-NO-TAILSCALE.md`, and the applicable platform repo configuration and operations instructions.
